author: makortel
body:
#### PR description:

The `IOExerciser` attempts to control the set of data products being read by getting them from the event. This approach has not worked as intended ever since the framework started to prefetch the data products the module declares to consume. But the file (TTree) information is not available at the module construction time in order to control the consumes() calls.

The same behavior on "data of only fraction of events are being read" can be achieved with the `AsciiOutputModule` or the `GenericConsumer`, and EDFilter(s) that control the fraction of events being read.

The behavior on selecting what data products would be read can be achieved by analyzing externally the file content upfront to decide what data products to read.

Resolves https://github.com/cms-sw/framework-team/issues/2511
